description: This Java class 'CollectionSheetTransactionDataValidator' provides validation logic for collection sheet transaction data in the Fineract project. It validates JSON input for various transaction-related parameters, including attendance, disbursements, repayments, savings, and payment details, ensuring data integrity before processing.

classes.name: CollectionSheetTransactionDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to collection sheet transactions, including attendance, disbursements, repayments, savings, and payment details.

methods.name: validateTransaction
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for a collection sheet transaction, checking required fields, attendance, disbursements, repayments, savings, and payment details.

methods.name: validateIndividualCollectionSheet
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for an individual collection sheet, including date validation and transaction details.

methods.name: validateAttendanceDetails
methods.description: Validates attendance details array within the JSON input.

methods.name: validateDisbursementTransactions
methods.description: Validates disbursement transaction entries within the JSON input.

methods.name: validateRepaymentTransactions
methods.description: Validates repayment transaction entries within the JSON input.

methods.name: validateSavingsDueTransactions
methods.description: Validates savings due transaction entries within the JSON input.

methods.name: validatePaymentDetails
methods.description: Validates payment detail fields such as payment type, account number, check number, etc.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if any validation errors have been collected.
